issues.description: Attribute type mismatch for fields numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents: the problem statement UML (Lecture class) declares these two attributes as double, while the solution implementation declares them as int. This inconsistency leaves students uncertain which numeric type to use for student counts and whether getTotalNumberOfStudents() should return int or double.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the numeric types for numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents across artifacts. Preferred fix: update the problem_statement UML to declare both attributes as int so it matches the solution and the getTotalNumberOfStudents() returning int. Alternative: if fractional student counts are intentionally allowed, update the solution and template to use double for those attributes and change getTotalNumberOfStudents() (and related methods) to return double consistently.
